name: Bottom navigation
guidance: 3–5 equal-width labeled destinations, one selected accent; pin outside scrolling content. Use the exact requested labels.

name: Search and filters
guidance: A real Text Field, compact filters with one selected state; no invented toolbar controls. Keep results in a separate section.

name: Product card
guidance: Artwork or intentional symbol illustration, product name, concise descriptor, price and one purchase action. Keep metadata subordinate.

name: Settings group
guidance: Grouped headings and distinct native Switch rows for boolean preferences; use chevrons only for drill-in navigation.

name: Week and agenda
guidance: Seven evenly spaced dates with one selected day and chronological agenda rows. Preserve weekday order and avoid cramped month grids on phones.

name: Conversation
guidance: Alternate incoming and outgoing alignment, distinguish bubbles with semantic surfaces and one accent, include discreet timestamps. Composer belongs at the bottom.

properties.text: Are we still on for tomorrow?

name: Pricing plan
guidance: Clear plan name, price and billing interval, 3 concise benefits, one primary subscription action; avoid invented discounts.

name: Checkout summary
guidance: Item summary, subtotal, delivery and total that add up. Show payment choice and one clear purchase action; never fake card details.

name: Empty state
guidance: One relevant symbol, a specific reason the view is empty and a useful action. Do not fabricate populated rows.

properties.text: Create your first project to get started.

name: Loading state
guidance: Subtle placeholders and honest indeterminate loading copy; no fake percentage. Keep the future content structure stable.

name: Error and retry
guidance: Explain the recoverable problem in plain language, preserve user work, and show a retry action. Never show backend diagnostics.

properties.text: Check your connection and try again.

name: Onboarding step
guidance: One benefit per step, intentional illustration, concise supporting text, step count and clear Continue action.
